bio.short: I'm a product designer who builds. At Bibel TV I made the design system an API that iOS, Android, web and connected TV read from one source. I designed in code against production APIs. 64% of the code behind the redesigned Android Home and detail views comes verbatim from my prototype (release 6.0, in beta). Before that I owned the design system of Ninox's no-code platform.
bio.long:
At Bibel TV, a broadcaster moving from linear TV to apps on iOS, Android, web and connected TV, I was Head of Product Design. I built the design system every platform reads its design decisions from, served from one source. A design-system MCP server and CLI let engineers and coding agents build with it directly. I designed in code against production APIs, and the Android app builds on that code. For the redesigned Home and detail views, 64% comes verbatim from my prototype (release 6.0, in beta). I also shipped a colour-extraction API that derives card gradients from artwork in OKLCH, with WCAG contrast held in light and dark. I built an AI Bible chat app for Bibel TV in about two months. I build with AI coding agents, and 2,195 automated tests stand behind the apps and the design system.

At Ninox I owned the design system of a no-code platform where customers build their own business apps, and established joint governance with engineering. As a consultant in summer 2025 I designed its prompt-to-database AI onboarding, with chat beside direct manipulation so people edit the schema the model proposed. It became the public AI beta's onboarding.

At Datameer I led the UX team for five years on data-dense analytics for leading US, Canadian and UK banks and insurers. I contributed component behavior and specs to the co-built design system. Selah, my Mac app on the Mac App Store, I designed and built solo.

context.company: Ashby builds recruiting and HR software used by over 100,000 weekly active users, with Design Engineering as its own department inside Engineering.
context.role: Staff Design Engineer: designs and implements complex product features end to end, extends the in-house design system, and consults on Product Engineers' designs.
context.emphasis: Lead with design systems as code and designing in code against production APIs, then complex configurable B2B products. AI coding agents named plainly as how he builds.
